Get Plunger'd: Cottage Brawl

A long weekend at the lake. Each day has six areas, then the Porcelain King in the outhouse. The cottage builds every area to test you, and it remembers how you played.

Pick your guy

On a phone, one hand is enough. Drag anywhere to move, and you swing your plunger on your own when a critter is close. Tap where you want to throw the big plunger. Flick your thumb to dash.

On a keyboard: move with WASD. Swing with J or the left mouse button. Throw a plunger with K or the right mouse button. Throw the big plunger with L, then walk over it to pull it back. Dash with Space. M turns sound on or off.

    Controls

    How to fight

    Critters flash and show a red wedge on the floor before they strike. Snapping turtles block hits from the front, so hit them from behind or stun them with the big plunger. Crates stop thrown things, and nail boards hurt critters too.

    Mood

    Watching

    The cottage picks a mood before each area. The mood changes what it offers you and what it sends at you.

    Decisions

    One entry per call to the director. Each shows the options it weighed and what it picked. On the live site Jev answers through Vercel AI Gateway, and the game samples from its probabilities. If Jev can't be reached, a local stand-in answers with the same shape.
